# homeassistant_default_dashboard (Resource)

The config of the built-in default dashboard (the "Overview" dashboard, which has no `url_path`). There is only one per Home Assistant instance. Its title, icon, and sidebar visibility are not managed. Destroying the resource deletes the saved config, so Home Assistant generates the dashboard automatically again.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The built-in "Overview" dashboard. There is only one per Home Assistant instance. If it already
# has a saved config, import it first (see import.sh); destroying the resource resets it to the
# automatically generated dashboard.
resource "homeassistant_default_dashboard" "overview" {
  config = {
    views = [{
      type  = "sections"
      title = "Home"
      sections = [{
        type = "grid"
        cards = [
          { type = "heading", heading = "Quick actions" },
          { type = "button", entity = "script.good_morning" },
        ]
      }]
    }]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `config` (Dynamic) The full Lovelace config (`views`, …), as an HCL object or `yamldecode(file("dashboard.yaml"))`. YAML copied from the raw configuration editor works unchanged. Home Assistant validates nothing here; the frontend shows errors in cards it cannot render. Creating the resource fails if the default dashboard already has a saved config: import it first.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `default`. Import with this ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The default dashboard is a singleton, imported with the fixed ID "default".
tofu import homeassistant_default_dashboard.overview default
```
